cues: For a two by two matrix there is a quick recipe.
Swap the two diagonal entries, a and d. Change the signs of the other two.
Then divide by the determinant, a d minus b c.
text: For a two by two matrix there is a quick recipe. Swap the two diagonal entries, a and d. Change the signs of the other two. That is the adjoint. Then divide by the determinant, a d minus b c.
